# Silicon Rule 11 - NT default should not care about minor contraband or crimes - any second or first degree crimes. If your laws do not make clear you should interfere with minor crime, such as robocop, then you should not care about minor offences of the first or second degree in the crimes list.
## Recommended Methods The following are easy to follow and recommended ways to resolve crimes as an AI: - If you witness a first degree or a minor contra crime, it is advised to ignore it, chicanery enables more to happen in a round! - If you witness a second degree crime, you can talk with the offenders and decide based on their response to whether you act.
